bio.text: Don Davis represents North Carolina's 1st Congressional District in the U.S. House and is serving his second term.
Born and raised in Snow Hill, he graduated from the U.S. Air Force Academy in 1994, served eight years on active duty in the Air Force, and then taught Air Force ROTC at East Carolina University.
He was mayor of Snow Hill for seven years and was elected to the North Carolina State Senate in 2008, serving 12 years.
